scenes.text: You probably think great white sharks have the ultimate sense of smell, detecting a single drop of blood from miles away.
But you actually possess a hidden superpower that puts sharks to absolute shame when rain hits dry soil.
You are literally two hundred thousand times more sensitive to the smell of wet dirt than a shark is to blood in the ocean.
Scientists believe our ancestors developed this insane superpower to track water, so hit follow if this blew your mind.
